source_note: 样本期望的渐近展开系数
english_source_note: Asymptotic Expansion Coefficients of Sample Means
callout_id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#2
statement_en: On a probability space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$, let $X_1,\dots,X_n,\dots$ be independent random variables with distribution $U(0,1)$. Find the limit of the expectation $$E \left [n\left(\frac{\overline{Y_n}}{\overline{X_n}}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\right],$$ where $\overline{Y_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i^2}{n}$ and $\overline{X_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i}{n}$.
key_techniques: analyze the ratio of sample means
use asymptotic expansion near the mean
callout_body:
在概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$上有一列独立且符合$U(0,1)$的随机变量$X_1,...,X_n,...$,求期望的极限:
$$E \left [n\left(\frac{\overline{Y_n}}{\overline{X_n}}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\right]$$其中$\overline{Y_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i^2}{n}$，以及$\overline{X_n} = \frac{\sum_{i\leq n} X_i}{n}$
